text:
Eastside Community Centre (fictional)
FALL SWIM LESSONS
Registration opens Monday, September 14, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. (online or in person).
Children's lessons (ages 4-12): Saturdays 10:00 a.m., 8 weeks, $68.00 per session.
Fee subsidy: Residents with a low income can apply for the recreation fee subsidy, which covers the full cost of most programs. Ask at the front desk for the application form.
